blocks.text: Research inquiries banane (formulate karne) ka matlab hai woh sawal banana jo aap ki research ko rasta dikhayein. Yeh sawal aap ki tawajjoh us cheez par rakhte hain jo aap seekhna aur jis ka jawab dhoondna chahte hain. Research questions ki mukhtalif qismein hoti hain, aur wazeh (clear) aur asar daar sawal banana achhi research ke liye zaroori hai.

blocks.title: Kitab se aage (aam ilm)
blocks.text: Kitab research questions ki qismein aur hypothesis bayan nahi karti, magar exercise un ke bare mein poochti hai. Mukhtasar: Exploratory question (khoj wala sawal) kisi kam samjhe gaye topic ko khangal kar maloom karta hai ke kya ho raha hai, maslan “Class XI ke students ki parhai ki aadatein kya hain?”. Explanatory question (wajah batane wala sawal) poochta hai ke koi cheez kyun ya kaise hoti hai, maslan “zyada sone wale students ke marks behtar kyun aate hain?”. Hypothesis (qabil-e-imtihan andaza) sawal ka aisa andaza hai jise data se test kiya ja sake, maslan “raat ko kam az kam aath ghante sone wale students kam sone walon se zyada marks lete hain”.
Maqsad: students research questions aur hypotheses banane ki mashq karein.

items: Koi aisa topic chunein jis ke bare mein aap jaanna chahte hain (maslan khurak (diet) ka students ki energy par asar, ya extracurricular activities (parhai ke ilawa sargarmiyon) ka grades par asar).
Apne topic se mutalliq ek specific (khaas) research question likhein.
Apne sawal ki buniyad par ek hypothesis banayein jise research se test kiya ja sake.
Apna sawal aur hypothesis class ke saath share karein aur baat karein ke us ka jawab dhoondne ke liye study (tehqeeq) kaise design karein.

blocks.title: Did You Know?
blocks.text:
Kya aap jante hain ke achhe research questions banana kamyab research project ka pehla qadam hai? Soch samajh kar banaya gaya sawal poori study ka rukh tay karta hai aur sahi jawab dhoondne par tawajjoh rakhta hai.

Yaad rakhein: sahi sawal poochna aur soch samajh kar andaza (informed guess) lagana seekh kar aap aise research projects bana sakte hain jo duniya ko samajhne mein hamari madad karein.

blocks.prompt: Research question banate waqt specific hona kyun zaroori hai? (MCQ 4)  Exploratory aur explanatory research questions mein farq bataiye. (Short question 3)  Research mein hypothesis kyun aham hai? (Short question 4)
blocks.explanation: MCQ 4: (b) taake wazeh ho ke aap kya jaanna chahte hain aur mubham (vague) sawalon se bacha ja sake. Short question 3: exploratory sawal kisi naye ya kam samjhe gaye topic ko khangal kar bayan karta hai ke kya ho raha hai; explanatory sawal kisi cheez ki wajah (kyun/kaise) dhoondta hai. Short question 4: hypothesis sawal ko ek qabil-e-test andaze mein badal deta hai; is se pata chalta hai ke kaunsa data jama karna hai, aur data se andaza sahi ya ghalat sabit hota hai, is liye research markooz (focused) rehti hai. (Short questions 3 aur 4 ka jawab aam ilm se hai; kitab yeh baatein bayan nahi karti.)

blocks.prompt: Wazeh aur markooz research question banane ka tareeqa achhi aur kharab misalon ke saath samjhaiye. (Long question 3)
blocks.explanation: Kisi wasee (broad) topic se shuru karein, phir us ke ek pehlu tak mehdood karein; batayein kis cheez ya kin logon ka mutala hai, kya napna hai aur kahan; aur dekh lein ke dastiyab data se jawab mil sakta hai. Kharab sawal: “Kya social media bura hai?” (mubham aur bohat wasee). Achha sawal: “Kya rozana do ghante se zyada social media istemal karne se hamare college ke Class XI students ka haftawar parhai ka waqt kam hota hai?” Is se hypothesis: “Rozana do ghante se zyada social media istemal karne wale students hafte mein kam ghante parhte hain.” (Misalein aam ilm se hain.)

items: Research inquiries: woh sawal jo research ko rasta dikhate hain.
Achha sawal wazeh aur specific ho; hypothesis us ka qabil-e-test andaza hai.
